lines.zh: 八条腿在落叶上走，声音很细。
lines.en: Eight legs cross the leaf litter with a fine sound.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面爬，肚子擦着土。
lines.en: I crawl low with my belly brushing the soil.
Half a block covers one of my strides.
I go around the root of a fern.
This body is small, but the legs are many.

lines.zh: 八条腿收拢，我从苔藓下钻出。
lines.en: Eight legs tucked, I crawl out from under the moss.

lines.zh: 我一边走，一边试探地面。
lines.en: I test the ground with each step.

lines.zh: 我的脚上有细毛，能感觉震动。
lines.en: Hairs on my feet feel the tremors.

lines.zh: 我沿着蕨叶边缘，慢慢挪。
lines.en: I creep along the fern edges, slow and steady.
I climb onto a dead leaf.
I cut through the grass.
I stop, then go on.
I walk up a tree trunk.
The soil under me is damp.
I move toward the darker ground.

lines.zh: 我的影子比身体大得多。
lines.en: My shadow is much bigger than my body.
I lie among the roots without moving.
I listen to the tremors in the ground.
An insect passed nearby.
My legs are slightly drawn in.
There is water on the leaf. I avoid it.

lines.zh: 我在等更小的东西过来。
lines.en: I wait for something smaller to come.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛有八只，看的方向不同。
lines.en: My eight eyes each look a different way.
The smell of wet wood is strong.

lines.zh: 我伏在落叶下，只露眼睛。
lines.en: I lie under the fallen leaves with only my eyes out.
A bird calls in the tree.
I turn my body slowly.
There is a web strung between two fern fronds.

lines.zh: 我的网上挂着几片碎叶。
lines.en: A few torn leaves cling to my web.

lines.zh: 有水滴从蕨叶上落下来。
lines.en: A drop falls from a fern frond.
Your foot is bigger than all of me.

lines.zh: 你脚落下来，我赶紧横着跑。
lines.en: Your foot comes down; I scuttle sideways.
All eight of my eyes are on you.

lines.zh: 我的螯肢举起来了，别碰。
lines.en: My chelicerae are raised. Do not touch.
I am bristled and look prickly.

lines.zh: 你身上有热，我感觉得到。
lines.en: You carry heat. I can feel it.

lines.zh: 你站得太近，影子盖住我了。
lines.en: Too close. Your shadow covers me.
I am small, but I have fangs.
To catch me you must bend down.
I have lived under this tree a long while.
One leg short, and still I can crawl.

lines.zh: 我缩成一团，八条腿都收着。
lines.en: I curl up with all eight legs tucked.

lines.zh: 被压进土里，八条腿还在挣。
lines.en: Pressed into the dirt, all eight legs still struggle.

lines.zh: 我身上流出一点淡色的水。
lines.en: A pale fluid has leaked from me.
I can still crawl, only slower.
I retreat under a leaf.
I broke my own web.
That left me listing to one side.
I crawl half a block away.

lines.zh: 我还活着，这具身体很结实。
lines.en: I am alive. This body is tough.
An insect. I wait.
That thing moves. It is not dead.
I smell small insects.
That is not enough for me.

lines.zh: 那点血味，让我忍不住靠近。
lines.en: That hint of blood draws me closer.

lines.zh: 你把东西放下，我来看看。
lines.en: Put it down and I will look.

lines.zh: 义县的林子里，我结小网。
lines.en: In Yixian woods I spin small webs.
Too hard. I give up.
A small insect landed nearby.
I will not eat that. Too small.
I withdrew under a leaf.
One touch and I spring away.
Your boot bent the grass.
I go around your foot.
That missed me. Lucky.
I crawl even lower.

lines.zh: 你的影子扫过来，我停了。
lines.en: Your shadow swept over and I froze.
Do not flick at me with a finger.
All eight legs retreat together.
I am not in the way. Do not step on me.
There are several webs between these roots.
One of us sits behind each web.
We never enter each other's webs.
One of them is a size bigger than me.
Its web is woven tighter than mine.
I spun a new one beside it.
At night we all hang at our web centers.
None of us goes to another.

lines.zh: 有网空了很久，虫也不来。
lines.en: One web has sat empty a long while.
I do not repair it. It is not mine.
A dead spider. Not mine. I leave it.
I pull down a small wad of silk.
Something small lies on the leaf.
I hold it with two front legs.
That much will feed me.

lines.zh: 这块比我还大，只能拖着走。
lines.en: This is bigger than me; I can only drag it.
I wrap it in silk.

lines.zh: 它掉下去了，我跟着下去。
lines.en: It fell and I went after it.
I hang it in my web.
I need not hide it. Nobody steals.
An insect has fallen into my web.

lines.zh: 网震了一下，我感觉得到。
lines.en: The web shuddered. I felt it.
Something moves on the ground.

lines.zh: 丝已经挂在两棵树之间了。
lines.en: My silk is already strung between two trees.
It is smaller than my eyes.

lines.zh: 八条腿一起发力，我扑过去。
lines.en: Eight legs drive at once, and I spring.
I am in the root's shadow.

lines.zh: 它还在梳毛，我数着距离。
lines.en: It is still grooming; I count the distance.

lines.zh: 这里只有一块石头挡着。
lines.en: Only one stone is in my way.

lines.zh: 前腿抬起，我等着它再近一步。
lines.en: Forelegs raised, I wait for it to come closer.

lines.zh: 义县的林子里，我的丝最细。
lines.en: My silk is the finest in the Yixian woods.
It has stopped and holds still.
I close in along the ground.
I'm no bigger than a fingertip.

lines.zh: 地面震的方式告诉我它在哪。
lines.en: The tremor tells me where it is.

lines.zh: 我顺着树根绕到它背后。
lines.en: I follow the roots around to its back.
Its legs are thicker than mine.

lines.zh: 我把丝挂在两片叶之间。
lines.en: I string my silk between two leaves.

lines.zh: 它靠着一棵树，挡住了半边。
lines.en: It is against a tree, half blocked.
I draw my body in small.
Its foot is right in front of me.
No sound now.
My front legs are already raised.
One more block will do.
I count the rhythm of its breathing.
I sink my fangs into the top of its foot.
All eight legs lunge together.
My fangs are small and sharp.
It kicked and I flew off.
I land on its boot.
I bite again, at the ankle.
It stomps down and I am already gone.
I climb up from below.
This one goes into its skin.
It jumps and I cling on.

lines.zh: 我吐了一丝网把它缠住。
lines.en: I spit a thread and bind its foot.
It kicks me loose and I tumble.

lines.zh: 我这么小，八条腿也够长。
lines.en: Small as I am, eight legs reach far.
This leaf litter is mine.

lines.zh: 我在两根蕨叶间结了网。
lines.en: I strung a web between two fern fronds.
I measure half a block across.
The Cretaceous wood is damp.

lines.zh: 我抬起两条前腿，试风向。
lines.en: I raise two front legs and test the wind.
A small insect immediately fled.
I lie flat on fallen needles.
There are fine spines on my legs.
The shadow of this tree is long.
I walk forward a short way.
The grass around me is taller than I am.

lines.zh: 我停下来，让身体贴紧地面。
lines.en: I stop and flatten myself.

lines.zh: 有一只同类在几格之外。
lines.en: Another of my kind is a few blocks away.
Fire touched me and my legs curled.

lines.zh: 我从树上掉下来，摔在落叶里。
lines.en: I fell from the tree into the leaf litter.

lines.zh: 水洼把我淹了，我划不动。
lines.en: A pool drowned me. I cannot paddle.

lines.zh: 爆响把落叶和土都掀起来。
lines.en: The blast threw leaves and soil up.
An arrow nearly pinned me down.

lines.zh: 怪光让我的腿都不听使唤。
lines.en: Strange light made all my legs disobey.

lines.zh: 好几天没虫，我越来越轻。
lines.en: No insects for days and I grow light.

lines.zh: 雷打在地上，我全身一麻。
lines.en: Lightning struck the ground and numbed me.
The soil split and I fell through.
